column3: Held up towards the back - improved into contention approaching two out - up into fourth by the last - driven into second on the run-in - got up to score right at the finish

Shared front spot early and clipped opponent at the first - lost top spot from the second - settled just behind the pace at halfway - back in front after two out - hit the front approaching the last - driven along and matched stride for stride inside final furlong - overtaken near the line
Held up towards the back - moved into contention behind the front group after two out - driven up into third before the last - stayed on at one speed without finding more late

Settled midpack early - closed on the front group by halfway - moved into 5th after the second-last - pressed on under urging to take 4th inside the final furlong-and-a-half and stayed on to finish fourth
Shared the front spot early - moved clear from second before being overtaken late - had nothing more to give and dropped away on the run to the line
Sat behind the front pack early - third at halfway - driven approaching 3 out and dropped to 9th before the last with nothing more to give - finished with a late flourish to end well held in 6th
Sat close to the front pair - 4th at halfway - серьезная error 7th - moved into second three out - held no more once challenged - dropped away approaching the last
Sat behind the pace - 6th at halfway - driven approaching 2 out - up to 5th before the last - held no rally and dropped away on the run to the line
Settled towards the back of the pack - moved into contention approaching third-last - unable to threaten from there - finished ninth well beaten
Settled around the centre of the field - hit the second-last awkwardly - unable to close from the final flight - well held at the finish
Held up towards the back - unable to make headway from 3 out - well beaten in 11th
Sat close to the front group early - 9th at halfway - dropped away from 4 out - finished well held in 12th
Sat close to the pace early - up to 5th at halfway - urged into 3rd after two out before fading fast approaching the last
Held up towards the back - never got competitive from 4 out and beaten a long way home
Held up in the pack from the off - unable to make an impression - well held in 15th
Sat close to pace early - moved into second by halfway - blundered three out then dropped away and was pulled up
Sat just behind the pace - asked for effort with 2f left - hit the front inside the final furlong and drew away for a comfortable win
Went straight to front - driven approaching 2f out then overtaken inside final furlong - stayed on for second unable to match winner
Held up towards the back - made smooth headway over 3f out - pushed into contention with 1f left - third close home but unable to close further
Held up at the back - driven into contention approaching the last two furlongs - finished fourth without further progress
Tracked the pace close up - urged forward with 3f left - dropped away inside final furlong
Settled in the pack early - roused with over 2f to go - unable to gain ground - finished sixth beaten just under 11 lengths
Tracked the front group early - urged forward with two furlongs left - faded steadily to finish seventh
Sluggish leaving the stalls - stayed at the back of the field for the remainder - finished 8th
Hesitant leaving the stalls - drifted to the back of the field - still within range at the 4f marker before being asked for effort - lost ground inside the final furlong to trail home ninth
Settled in the pack - drifted wide and ran out on the bend with 5f left - effectively over from there

Held up towards back of the pack - improved into 6th three out - driven into 3rd after the following fence - closed to dispute matters but hampered by a stumble at the last - shaken up to hit the front inside the final furlong and stayed on strongly
Set the pace early - stumbled after the last and needed driving - held on gamely until edged out inside the final furlong and a half to finish second

Held up towards the back - improved into the middle of the pack three out - closed on the front group after the second-last - up to fifth entering the final fence - pushed along and finished well to move into third inside the final 200 yards but couldn't find more late on
Sat handy behind front group - moved into 3rd approaching 3 out then edged into 2nd after the following fence - dropped back to 4th with nothing more before last - stayed on same rate to finish 4th
Sat close to pace early - 5th with three furlongs left - urged on after the following fence - improved into third approaching the last - flattened out under pressure and slipped back to finish 5th
Tracked pace-setter early - still second at halfway - hit 2 out then lost touch before the last
Held up towards back of pack - blundered three out - shaped up better into the finish but no real threat - eventually well held in 7th
Held up towards the back - edged closer from 2 out - well held at the finish
Held up towards the back of the pack - unable to make headway from 3 out - well held at the finish
Held up towards the back - unable to make headway from 3 out - well held at the finish
Handy up with the front group early - third at halfway then fourth with three left - dropped away after that and well held at the finish
Sat close to the pace early - up in 4th at halfway - dropped away from 3 out - well held at the finish
Held up in the pack - mistake 7th - always struggling to get involved - well held at finish
Sat close to the pace early - 6th at halfway - dropped away from 5 out and finished well adrift
settled midpack early - driven up to reach contention over 2f out - hit the front a furlong out - edged off a true line but kept finding under pressure - allowed to coast home in front
Sat close up on rail early - roused 2f out and made ground - stayed on to chase home winner
Set the pace early - driven forward before 2f out - lost the advantage by a whisker approaching the final furlong and kept trying but never got back on top - finished third
Travelled close up wide - asked for effort with over 2f left - edged in front briefly inside final furlong before being overtaken - held on for fourth without further gain
Settled midpack early - urged for effort with over two furlongs left - failed to find extra and finished well held
Held a midpack spot wide - moved into fourth approaching halfway then asked for effort 3f out - lost ground inside the final furlong to finish sixth
Slowly away - held up at the back - detached from the field from 2f out
Towards the back - struggled 3f out and dropped right away - allowed to coast home 8th
Set the pace from the off - urged forward approaching two out - driven out after the last - held on under a determined late challenge to score
Held up towards the back of the pack - up into 4th at halfway - hit the second-last - moved into second nearing the final fence - pushed along and battled on up the run-in - narrowly denied
Held up towards the back - mistake 3rd - moved into 5th 3 out - driven approaching 2 out then up to 4th - into 3rd early in the straight - held on for a one-paced third
Sat close to pace early - jumped awkwardly three out - driven approaching two out with little response - held in fourth through the closing stages
Sat just behind the front group early - third at halfway - asked for effort after two out but found little and slipped to fifth before the last - stayed on same gear to the line finishing 5th
Settled in the pack - unable to make headway from 3 out - finished 6th beaten 5 lengths
Held up at the back - no impression made - finished well beaten in 7th
Tracked front group early - urged forward 2f out into second - driven 1f out - edged in front close home - stayed on strongly to win
Settled midfield early - urged forward with 2f to run and made ground - battling for third with a furlong left - stayed on to just miss but couldn't quite reel in winner
Held a forward position early - asked for effort over 2f out and edged left - stayed on well through the closing stages - closing strongly to finish third
Sat close to pace early - hit front 3f out - driven with over 2f out - lost lead close to home - held on for fourth
Front early - gave way 3f out under pressure - kept on without ever threatening to get back involved and finished 5th
Held up towards the back - urged forward with 2f left - stayed on late but held for 6th
Slow to break - held up at the back - urged forward with 2f left - stayed on late without getting competitive
Settled in a useful position early - urged into effort over 2f from home - lost momentum inside final furlong - eventually held on for eighth beaten four lengths
Held handy in the pack early - nudged for effort inside final two furlongs - dropped away in closing stages - finished 9th beaten 4½ lengths
Held up towards the back - stayed on late passing tired horses - always short of a threat - finished tenth
Slow to break - held towards the back - urged approaching final two furlongs but unable to find any headway - finished well held in 11th
Tracked the front group early - urged forward with 2f left - lost ground inside the final furlong - eventually beaten 6 lengths in 12th
Settled midfield early - driven for effort with 2f left - unable to respond finishing well held in 13th
Settled around midfield - urged forward with over 2f left - dropped away inside the final furlong - finished 14th
Held up near the back - driven approaching final furlong - denied room and let up soon after finishing 15th
Held a midfield spot early - urged for effort inside final two furlongs - dropped away in the closing stages - finished well back in 16th
Sat handy behind pace - hit front from 5th - driven out beyond final fence - held rivals in tight finish under maximum effort

Held up towards the back of the pack early - improved into contention 3 out - fourth turning into the straight - up into third with 200 yards left - into second inside the final furlong - chased the winner all the way to the line and edged out narrowly
Sat just behind the pace - midfield turning through halfway - moved into second two out - driven approaching the last - found little under pressure and eased back to third close home
Sat handy behind front rank - asked for effort in 5th two out - up into 4th after last - stayed on same rate to finish 4th
Sat close behind the front group - moved into 3rd approaching 3 out - drifted left and driven wide over the last - found little thereafter and eased back to finish 5th
Held up towards back of pack - hampered two out then driven closer to front before last - stayed on same speed to finish sixth
Sat close to the pace early - moved into second 3 out then pressed for third after the following fence - lost momentum before the last and held on for seventh
Held up towards the back - some progress into the middle of the pack approaching 2 out - stayed on at one speed without finding more from the last
Held up towards the back - checked 2 out - unable to close from there - eventually well held
Held up towards the back of the pack - clipped the 2nd fence - driven forward after 3 out but unable to close from there - well held at the finish
Held up in the back group - moved into contention to sit 7th three out - had nothing left approaching the following fence and dropped away steadily to finish well beaten
Sat close to the front early - held 7th at the midway point - dropped away from 5 out and finished well behind
Held up in the pack early - lost touch with the field - pulled up before 4 out
Set the early pace before being overtaken - sat 4th at halfway - unable to find more three out - came down at the following fence
Sat close to pace early - moved through to briefly hit front early on - lost that spot 5th - dropped away 4 out and pulled up before 2 out
Settled just behind the leading duo - moved left to strike into second with 2f remaining - hit the top a furlong out - pushed along inside the final 110yds - stayed on strongly to score
Set the gallop early - driven approaching 2f out then overtaken inside final furlong under pressure - held to same effort to finish clear second
Sat close to the front group - urged forward nearing 2f out - stayed on without threatening to land the finish - held for third
Held second early - driven for effort with 2f left - dropped back soon after - faded inside final furlong to finish fourth
Held up at the back - urged forward with over 2f left - dropped away and finished well adrift in 5th

Held up towards back - still midfield at halfway - closed on the pack after 2 out - up into sixth last - moved into second early in the straight - hit the front inside the final furlong and stayed on strongly

Settled in the pack early - lost touch and slipped backward around halfway - roused after two out and squeezed for room before the last - improved into 4th early in the straight - up to 3rd inside the final furlong - closed to finish 2nd
Sat just behind the front group - driven into the advantage in the closing stages before losing that spot with a furlong and a half left - unable to find more and slipped back to finish third

Held up towards the back - untidy two out - driven into the middle of the pack near the last - bumped lightly with another runner early in the straight - edged up to third close home before finding nothing more and finishing fourth
Shared the pace early - settled second behind the front-runner - urged forward approaching two out - held third but couldn't quicken and dropped away on the run to the line

Sat behind the front group early - lying 5th at halfway - nudged for effort after two out then bumped mildly turning into the straight - asked for more out wide after the last - unable to find more and held on for 6th
Sat behind front group early - through midfield at halfway - asked for effort approaching final two furlongs and stayed on same rate from the last to finish seventh beaten 5.5 lengths
Shared the pace early - hit the front from the 2nd - driven up when overtaken near the finish - dropped away over 200 yards out to finish eighth
Held up towards the back - improved into 6th two out - driven approaching last then found little and dropped away on the run to the line
Sat close to the pace - moved into 4th three out - driven on but found little after the following fence and clouted the last - lost touch soon after and finished well held
Settled in the pack - unable to make headway from 3 out - well held at the finish
Sat close to front group early - up in 4th at halfway - driven for effort after two out and lost ground before the final fence
Held up towards the back - awkward over the opening two obstacles and needed encouragement - unable to make an impression - well held in 13th
Held up towards the back - made no real headway - well held throughout - finished last of the finishers

Settled fourth early - moved into contention 2f out - driven to close on front-runner before edging ahead inside final furlong - kept finding under pressure in the closing stages - held on by a whisker at the line

Sat behind the leading duo on the inner - held up for room from over 2f out before edging out and driven approaching the final furlong - moved right to be third with a furlong left - finished with a determined effort - pipped in the shadow of the post
Sat close up in second - went in front 2f out and pushed along under pressure - edged ahead of near the furlong marker - kept going but flattened out and slipped a spot close home
Handy in a tucked-away spot early - driven and moved left approaching the final furlong - kept responding to the line - lacked the speed to reach the leaders in fourth
Set the pace early - lost front spot two out under pressure - dropped away nearing final furlong to finish fifth

Handy in the pack early - closed into fifth four out - driven on approaching two out - up into third after the last - asked for extra to take second early in the run-in - stayed on strongly to hit the front near the finish

Sat close to the front pack - clipped a fence 4 out - urged forward after 2 out - stayed level in 3rd until bumped and thrust in front after the last - driven out and battled on up the run-in but overtaken close home

Up with the front early - 2nd at halfway - struggled for momentum after 2 out and 4th before being hampered and promoted 2nd at the last - soon under pressure and fell back to 3rd over 1f out - plugged on at one speed on the run-in
Held up at the back - lost touch after 4 out - eased into distant fourth from the last - stayed on steadily to finish well behind
Held up towards the back - hampered at the opening obstacle - stayed on steadily from 2 out to take 5th near the finish
Held second rank early - midfield by halfway - unable to quicken from four out and edged back late
Held up towards the back - eased into the pack from 4 out - never a factor - well held
Held up towards the back - checked shortly after the opening fence - always struggling to get involved - well beaten in 8th
Settled in the pack early - unable to close from four out - well held at the finish
Held up towards the back - no impression made - well held throughout - finished 10th
Held up at the back from the off - lost touch with the field early - well beaten and eased through the finish - came home last
Sat close to front pair - came down at the opening fence
Sent clear early - holding advantage comfortably approaching last - came down at the final fence
Sat close to the pace - up to 4th at halfway then moved into 2nd after the second-last - brought down at the final obstacle
Held up towards the back - hampered at the opening obstacle - unable to make headway from halfway and eased out of contention before the last
Slow to begin - settled towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - finding more late inside final furlong - got up to score close home

Up with the pace early - pushed along 2f out - moved through to hit the front over a furlong out but drifted right - stayed on strongly in the closing stages - caught in the final strides to be beaten a short head
Set the pace early - overtaken after a furlong - regained command 6f from home - pushed along with 2f left - drifted left before losing top spot inside the final furlong - stayed on to finish third

Sluggish start - up with the front group early and briefly in command after a furlong under pressure - lost the advantage with 6f left - pushed along 2f out - unable to find more inside the last - finished fourth beaten 2.75 lengths
Settled towards the back - angled left with 2f to run and pushed along approaching the furlong marker - lost ground close home to finish 5th
Settled in the pack - pushed into contention 6f out then pressed for effort 2f out - lost ground final furlong to finish sixth
Sat close to the front pack - third at halfway - moved into second after the final fence - took command entering the straight - stayed on for a comfortable win
Sat behind the pacesetter early - still second at halfway - edged in front approaching the final obstacle before being overtaken entering the run-in - one-paced thereafter and held on for second

Held up at the back of the pack - clipped another runner at the opening obstacle - crept forward to sit seventh by the midpoint - up to fifth three out then fourth soon after - driven into third turning for home - couldn't find more but stayed on at one speed to finish third
Set the early gallop - driven and lost the advantage nearing the last then found little in 4th turning in - stayed on at a single gear to the line finishing 4th
Sat close to the front group - urged forward after the second-last then slipped to 5th before the final flight - unable to find more and stayed on steadily to finish fifth
Sat close to the front group early - asked for effort approaching two out then held sixth without finding more - stayed on at the same rate to the line finishing sixth
Sat close to the front group - driven from three out then blundered the following fence and made no progress - lost touch after the last and faded home well beaten
Sat close to the front group early - slipped towards the back by halfway - unable to make headway from 3 out - well held at the finish
Held up at the back - unable to make an impression - well held throughout
Held up towards the back - unable to make headway from 3 out - well held at the finish
Settled midfield early - clipped another runner at the first - slipped towards the back by halfway - no headway from 3 out and well held at the finish
Held up towards back of field from the off - lost touch with rivals through the middle stages - well beaten at the finish
Held up towards the back - parted with rider at the 3rd
Settled in the pack early - driven up into contention with 2f left - drifted left to hit the front inside the final furlong - kept going to score
Set the pace early - urged forward 2f out - drifted right and lost front spot approaching final furlong - kept trying but couldn't find more late
Held a handy spot early - advanced into fourth 3f out then dropped away under pressure 2f out - finished strongly in the final furlong to snatch third on the line
Fought rider early - tracked front group before angling left 2f out under pressure - drifted left and held same effort to finish 4th beaten 2.5 lengths
Held up towards the back - driven into contention before 2f out to press for fourth - hampered nearing the final furlong and finished one-paced in 5th
Handy in the early running - driven from over 2f out then squeezed for room and knocked sideways by rivals approaching the last furlong - unable to get back into contention finishing 6th
Tracked the pace early - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away quickly soon after - finished well held in 7th
Settled in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left then lost touch - well held at the finish
Restrained towards the back - dropped away over 1f out and finished a distant ninth
Settled at the back early - under pressure and losing touch before halfway - well beaten at the finish

Held a midpack spot early - asked for effort three furlongs out - made ground under pressure with two to go - drifted right but hit the front approaching the final furlong - drew away inside it to score in style
Set the pace early - opened a big gap 6f out - margin shortened by 4f out - urged along inside the last 3f - overtaken a furlong out - fought back late but not enough to trouble the winner
Handy early - urged into effort 3f out then made ground 2f out - kept on at one speed from the final furlong to finish third
Settled with the field early - crept closer approaching 3f out then angled right under pressure with 2f left - unable to add further threat late on and faded inside the last furlong

Prominent early - tracked the pacesetter with a big gap 6f from home - narrowed the deficit 4f out - pushed along 3f out - drew alongside 2f out but couldn't better rival and dropped away in the final furlong - finished 5th
Handy with the front group early - squeezed for room and asked for effort over 2f out - lost momentum inside final furlong to finish sixth
Settled at the back early - pushed to close 4f out and edged forward 3f out - unable to threaten leaders finishing 7th
Held up in the pack - no real progress made - eventually beaten a long way - finished eighth
Settled at back of field - losing touch approaching 4f out - never a threat and well beaten late
Held up towards the back of the pack - pushed along and gave way 3f out - eventually well held in 10th
Sat behind the front group early - weakened 4f out and slipped towards the back - well adrift with 2f to run
Settled towards the back early - dropped away well over 4f from home before being eased to a halt - found to have bled from the nose
Set the pace from the off - given a nudge and edged left 3f out - asked for effort inside final furlong - kept responding to the line before slowing up close home

Settled midpack early - roused approaching 3f out then finished strongly under pressure - chased the front-runner late but couldn't reel in - kept on to finish second beaten three-quarters of a length
Handy in the pack early - moved through to third with over a furlong left - driven out but stayed at one gear to finish third
Dwelt at the start - settled at the back - driven into contention over 2f out - kept on late - moved into fourth close home - held at the line
Handy early - urged forward 3f out - stayed on but lacked the speed to get involved
Held up towards the back - urged forward with over 2f left - finished with a late rally but never threatened the front - came home sixth beaten just under three lengths
Held up towards the back - pushed along with over 2f left - stayed on without getting close to the front runners - finished 7th beaten 3.25 lengths
Sat close to the front group early - pressed for effort 2f out - dropped away quickly inside the final furlong - finished 8th beaten 3.75 lengths
Held up towards the back - given a squeeze for effort with over 2f left - unable to challenge - finished ninth beaten 3.75 lengths
Held in the pack - urged forward 3f out - couldn't respond - finished well held in 10th
Tracked leader in second - urged forward 3f out - dropped away rapidly 2f out - finished 11th
Handy with the front group early - pushed along inside final furlong - rallied to hit the front close home - edged clear in the last strides
Settled towards the back - made progress from over 2f out - drifted left under pressure inside final furlong - kept on well through closing stages - nabbed second late - denied by a short margin
Held a midpack position - eased left and pushed out approaching final furlong - finished strongly to grab third close home
Set the early pace - dropped back after a furlong - regained front soon after - pushed along a furlong out - overtaken in the closing strides and eased back to finish 4th
Held a forward spot - pressed for effort 2f out - couldn't quicken inside final furlong - held for 5th
Sluggish start settling towards the back - moved into contention after 3f - pushed along with 2f left - knocked off balance inside final furlong - weakened quickly after
Held up in the pack - pushed along with 2f left before drifting left approaching the furlong marker - stayed on at a steady effort to finish seventh
Slow to get going - settled towards the back then improved position over 2f out - dropped away final furlong to finish 8th
Asked for early effort - hit front inside first furlong - overtaken by second furlong - urged again 3f out - dropped away 2f out - finished ninth well beaten
Fought for control early - up with the pace before tracking front group after 3f - urged on 3f out - dropped away soon after finishing well held
Tracked front group wide - hit front two out and driven on - shown the whip inside final furlong - edged clear late to prevail
Held up towards the back - driven into contention over 2f out - briefly boxed in and shifted right for room - kept responding from inside the final furlong - denied close home but flying at the line
Held a midfield spot wide of rivals - urged forward and made headway over 2f out - into fourth with a furlong left - kept responding to the line but short of the speed to land the finish
Handy early - hit front 3f out - driven and lost advantage 2f out - stayed on but couldn't find more in the run to the line
settled in the pack early - improved on the inside approaching 3f out - pushed into third with a furlong left - weakened close to home to finish fifth
Sat close to the front pack early - urged forward with 3f remaining - kept going without finding extra - finished 6th beaten 4.25 lengths
Held up towards the back - pushed along with two furlongs left - stayed on modestly in closing stages to finish 7th beaten 4.5 lengths
Settled in the pack - nudged for effort with over 2f left - unable to find any gain thereafter - finished 8th
Poor start - stayed towards the back - made no impact through the race - finished well held in 9th
Slow to break - held up towards the back - never got involved - finished well beaten in 10th
Well placed early - hit front after 2f before giving way 3f out - dropped away quietly and finished well held
Made the running early - lost front spot before 2f gone - stayed with front group briefly - faded rapidly beyond 3f from home - eased and taken out of contention
Held up at the back - urged forward approaching 2f out - shifted left and surged into contention inside the final 2f - hit the front 1f out - kicked away entering the last furlong - won comfortably
Slow to break - settled towards the back - urged along and gained ground over 2f out - closed on the front pair inside the final furlong - stayed on into second
Settled in the pack early - urged along and closed on the front group approaching final furlong - stayed on to finish third

Sat behind the front group early - asked for more effort with 2f left - shifted left before gaining ground inside the final furlong - stayed on to the line but lacked the finishing speed to get on terms - finished fourth beaten 4 1/4 lengths
Set the pace early - lost front spot after 2f and sat handy - driven on with 2f to run and closed up with 1f left - couldn't land a blow and dropped away finishing fifth
Settled towards the back of the pack - urged forward approaching 2f out - made late progress but never a threat to the front group - stayed on to finish sixth

Settled with strong grip early - up with pace and went in front after 2f - pressed for effort 2f out - wandered left under pressure inside final 2f - gave up advantage a furlong out - had nothing left and dropped away to finish 7th
Settled off the pace early - pushed for effort with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong - finished eighth
Settled with the pack early - pushed for effort with two furlongs left - edged sideways and lost ground inside the final furlong - eventually beaten well home in 9th
Held up in the pack early - stayed off the pace throughout - well beaten in 10th
Fighting for control early - up with the pace - pushed for effort with 2f left before fading in the final furlong
Settled in the pack - drifted wide and slipped back over 2f out - soon well held
Settled near the back - losing touch approaching final 3f - well beaten at the finish
Pulled hard early - among the leading group - urged forward 4f out - dropped back 3f out - faded fast 2f out - well beaten by the final furlong
Settled midfield early moving well - improved into contention over 2f out - closed on front pair inside final furlong under encouragement - hit the front close home - kept up the pressure to score

Held up towards the back - urged forward over 2f out and made headway - stayed on inside the final furlong to take third then edged into second close home - finished second beaten three quarters of a length
Just in front early - driven forward with two furlongs left - drifted left inside the final furlong - overtaken close home - held on for third
Up with the leading duo - left behind and dropped back over 1f out - kept on inside the final furlong but unable to threaten - fourth
Slowly away - settled in midpack - ridden to chase over 1f out - plugged on without menacing the principals
Held handy in the pack early - roused for effort with two furlongs left - kept going without gaining finished sixth beaten under five lengths
Slow to start - held up towards the back before angling left and driving through over 2f out - involved in fight for third with 1f left - dropped away inside final furlong
Held up towards the back - urged forward with 2f left - unable to find any headway
Sat close to pace early - asked for effort with 2f left - lost ground final furlong - finished 9th
Held around midfield early - driven for effort approaching 2f out but lost touch - dropped away thereafter to finish well held
Slow into stride - held up at the back throughout - never a factor - finished 11th
Held handy in the pack early - asked for effort and lost touch inside final 2f - eased right out of contention late - finished 12th
Held up towards the back - failed to threaten in the second half - finished well held in 13th
Urged forward early at back of field - made progress into mid-pack around 4f out - driven to the front approaching final furlong - drew away to score with ease
Up with the front rank - knocked about after 1f - niggled into contention and hit the front just past the 1f pole - found only one gear through the final furlong - finished second 6½ lengths adrift

Settled in the pack early - slipped towards the back after the first furlong - lost touch when severely checked on the turn 4f out - pushed along and left trailing 3f out - rallied from 2f out - moved into third late to finish creditably in defeat

Raced eagerly early - tracking the front group - drifted right and clipped another runner after 1f - given a squeeze approaching the 4f marker then asked for effort 2f out - stayed on at same speed to finish fourth
Held up towards the back - lost touch approaching 3f out - toiling from 2f out to finish well held in 5th
Set the early pace - drifted left under pressure and lost the advantage inside the final furlong - dropped away quickly after
Handy early - driven approaching 3f out then dropped away 2f out - faded through final furlong to finish seventh
Held up towards the back - improved into contention after 2f - pressed on approaching final 2f before fading
Sluggish start - settled in the pack - ran into trouble and was eased to a halt with 4f left
Settled in the pack - picked up ground smoothly threading a path with plenty in hand from 2f out - hit the front inside the final 110yds and pulled clear
Slow to break - held up towards the back - made smooth headway from over 3f out - up into fourth and pushed along a furlong out - stayed on but unable to reel in the winner
Handy on the wide side early - hit front after 4f - pushed along with a furlong left - overtaken close to home and stayed on same speed to finish third
Settled in the pack early - improved into contention over 2f out and edged into second inside the final furlong - flattened out close home to finish fourth beaten 3.5 lengths
Tracked leading group early - driven with two furlongs remaining - unable to quicken approaching the last furlong - finished 5th
Tardy away - settled towards the back - roused up approaching the final 2f - kept on inside the last but always held in 6th
Sent forward early to take command - overtaken after 4 furlongs but stayed in touch - given encouragement 3f from home - faded in the closing stages to finish 7th
Settled midpack early - pushed along with two furlongs left - unable to land a blow - finished eighth beaten 7½ lengths
Held up early - settled off the pace - never involved - well held at the finish
Sat close to the front early - urged forward with two furlongs left - dropped away before the final furlong - eventually finished tenth
